what: Scattered pieces (spotted horse, speech bubbles, stickers) pop out in sequence from .8x scale and transparent at .1s intervals, each with an extra random 0–1s delay so they burst in off-beat — default .8s back.out(3), once when the group’s top edge reaches 80% of the screen. Term speech bubble type uses 1s elastic.out(2), start center bottom

options.dur: Length of one piece (sec), default .8 — bubble 1
options.ease: Curve, default back.out(3) — speech bubble elastic.out(2)
options.random: Max random delay (seconds), default 1 — 0 means sequence only
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top 80% — speech bubble center bottom

from.where: index.html .hm-copy__list (watercolor smudge text) · .hm-terms__list (term speech bubbles, dur 1 · elastic.out(2) · center bottom)
